pairs.target: xīn zhàozǐ shǎo le yíkuài , kànshàngqù dǎoxiàng zuò huài le .
pairs.english: A piece was missing from the new hood, making it look botched.

pairs.target: tǎ wéi ná tā duì zhe chuāng , guāng cóngqián xiàfāng kuān chūlái de kǒuzǐ lòujìnlái , zhào zài tā shǒuwàn shàng .
pairs.english: Tavi held it towards the window; light leaked through the widened lower-front opening onto his wrist.

pairs.target: tiē yīfu de yímiàn réng fēng zhe , wàicè què búzài bǎ guāngshù shōuchéng xiǎoxiǎo yígè yuán .
pairs.english: The clothing side remained closed, but the outside no longer gathered the beam into a tiny circle.
pairs.hanzi: 贴衣服的一面仍封着，外侧却不再把光束收成小小一个圆。

pairs.target: sū yǐ jiānchí ràng tā bǎ jiǎnxiàlái de jīnshǔpiàn liú zhe , wàn yīkǒu kāi dé tài dà , hái néng duìzhào zhe gǎi .
pairs.english: Suyi insisted he keep the cut-off metal, so they could compare and revise if the opening proved too large.
pairs.hanzi: 苏苡坚持让他把剪下来的金属片留着，万一口开得太大，还能对照着改。

pairs.target: nà liǎngdào báishí xiàn liúzài yuànlǐ , yǐjīng bèi jiǎo cǎi dàn le .
pairs.english: The two white-stone lines remained in the yard, faded by footsteps.
pairs.hanzi: 那两道白石线留在院里，已经被脚踩淡了。

pairs.target: tāmen chèn zhíshǒu shíchén , yòng shǒu dēng zhàozhe kōng zhào shì guò jǐcì ,
pairs.english: During supervised sessions they'd shone a hand lamp through the empty hood several times,
pairs.hanzi: 他们趁值守时辰，用手灯照着空罩试过几次，

pairs.target: yòu lúnliú bào xiāng , títǒng , cái dìngxià xiànzài de kāikǒu .
pairs.english: then taken turns carrying crates and buckets before settling on this opening.
pairs.hanzi: 又轮流抱箱、提桶，才定下现在的开口。

pairs.target: liǎngchù guàdiǎn zhījiān jiā le yìgēn duǎn héngtiáo ,
pairs.english: A short crosspiece now joined the two hanging points,
pairs.hanzi: 两处挂点之间加了一根短横条，

pairs.target: ā duō cèshēn shí , jiàzi búzài gēnzhe bùdài nǐngchéng yígè xiéjiǎo .
pairs.english: so when Ado turned, the frame wouldn't twist sideways with the belt.
pairs.hanzi: 阿多侧身时，架子不再跟着布带拧成一个斜角。

pairs.target: zuìhòu shèngxià yìzhī kǎkòu .
pairs.english: Only a clasp remained.
pairs.hanzi: 最后剩下一只卡扣。

pairs.target: kǎkòu yào néng ràng ā duō zhāixià zhěng zhǎndēng , búbì xiān jiě yāodài .
pairs.english: It had to let Ado remove the whole lamp without first undoing the belt.
pairs.hanzi: 卡扣要能让阿多摘下整盏灯，不必先解腰带。

pairs.target: liǎngpiàn yǐjīng chéngxíng de xiǎo piàn dié zài yìqǐ , zhōngjiān chuān xiāo , wěiduān háiyǒu yìgēn duǎn huáng yāzhù .
pairs.english: Two small preformed pieces overlapped, with a pin through the middle and a short spring pressing at the end.
pairs.hanzi: 两片已经成形的小片叠在一起，中间穿销，尾端还有一根短簧压住。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zhàozhe chāixiè shùnxù bǎihǎo língjiàn , fāxiànzìjǐ de liǎngzhīshǒu yídàn ànzhù duǎn huáng , jiù méiyǒu shǒu chuān nà méi xiāo le .
pairs.english: Tavi laid out the parts in dismantling order and found that holding the spring down took both hands, leaving none for the pin.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维照着拆卸顺序摆好零件，发现自己的两只手一旦按住短簧，就没有手穿那枚销了。

pairs.target: luóxuán jiá dāngrán néng zuò .
pairs.english: A screw clamp could of course do it.
pairs.hanzi: 螺旋夹当然能做。

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī què tóngyì tā bǎ zhè yíbù dàidào liànxí táishàng , yòng tā liàn guò de nà zǔ xiǎo tiě yàng , shì yícì zhēnzhèng de zhuāngpèi .
pairs.english: But Instructor Vey agreed he could bring this step to the practice bench and try a real assembly with his familiar small iron samples.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师却同意他把这一步带到练习台上，用他练过的那组小铁样，试一次真正的装配。

pairs.target: dēng hé dēngyóu liúzài lìng yìzhāng zhuōshàng .
pairs.english: The lamp and oil stayed on another table.
pairs.hanzi: 灯和灯油留在另一张桌上。

pairs.target: táishàng de liǎngpiàn tiě réng shì yuánlái de tǐjī hé kè cáo , qīngzǎi , dǎng kuài yě méiyǒu gǎi .
pairs.english: The two iron pieces retained their original volumes and grooves, with light loads and stops unchanged.
pairs.hanzi: 台上的两片铁仍是原来的体积和刻槽，轻载、挡块也没有改。

pairs.target: tāmen zhī kòngzhì yìgēn yā gān , línshí bǎ duǎn huáng yā zài qiàhǎo de wèizhì ;
pairs.english: They controlled only a lever temporarily holding the small spring in position;
pairs.hanzi: 它们只控制一根压杆，临时把短簧压在恰好的位置；

pairs.target: jiè xìng búhuì bǎ kǎkòu biàn jiēshi , gèng búhuì tì tā bǎ língjiàn nián zài yìqǐ .
pairs.english: the exchange wouldn't strengthen the clasp, much less glue its parts together.
pairs.hanzi: 借性不会把卡扣变结实，更不会替他把零件粘在一起。

pairs.target: xiāo chuān hǎo le , kào de shì zìjǐ de dǎng tóu liúzhù .
pairs.english: Once inserted, the pin would stay by its own retaining head.
pairs.hanzi: 销穿好了，靠的是自己的挡头留住。

pairs.target: luò héng zuòzài jìlù nàbiān , kànjiàn tā bǎ xiāo zài qiǎndié lǐ pái dé duānduānzhèngzhèng , shuō yòu búshì yào gěi tāmen shàngkè .
pairs.english: From the recording side, Lohen saw the neatly arranged pins in the shallow dish and said they weren't here for lessons.
pairs.hanzi: 洛衡坐在记录那边，看见他把销在浅碟里排得端端正正，说又不是要给它们上课。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiào le , bǎ qízhōng yìméi zhuǎnhuí shùnshǒu de fāngxiàng .
pairs.english: Tavi laughed and turned one pin back to an easier angle.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维笑了，把其中一枚转回顺手的方向。

pairs.target: děng lǎoshī quèrèn yā gān de wèizhì , tā shuāngshǒu jiēshàng luǒ miàn .
pairs.english: After the teacher checked the lever's position, he put both hands on the bare patches.
pairs.hanzi: 等老师确认压杆的位置，他双手接上裸面。

pairs.target: shúxī de liǎngzhǒng xiǎngyìng zài zhǎng xià fēnkāi , tā wěnzhù , méiyǒu zài wǎng shēnchù tuī .
pairs.english: The familiar responses diverged beneath his palms; he held steady without pressing deeper.
pairs.hanzi: 熟悉的两种响应在掌下分开，他稳住，没有再往深处推。

pairs.target: táishǒu hòu de dìyīshēng qīng xiǎng hái méi wánquán luòxià , xiāo yǐjīng chuānguò duìqí de kǒng .
pairs.english: Before the first soft click after lifting his hands had fully faded, the pin was through the aligned holes.
pairs.hanzi: 抬手后的第一声轻响还没完全落下，销已经穿过对齐的孔。

pairs.target: tā fàng kāixiāo , shuāngshǒu tóngshí huídào tiě yàng shàng , jiéshù jiāohuàn .
pairs.english: He released it, returned both hands to the iron samples together, and ended the exchange.
pairs.hanzi: 他放开销，双手同时回到铁样上，结束交换。

pairs.target: yā gān tuìhuíqù , kǎkòu méiyǒu sàn .
pairs.english: The lever withdrew. The clasp stayed together.
pairs.hanzi: 压杆退回去，卡扣没有散。

pairs.target: luò héng hé wán dúshù , tǎ wéi cái ná qǐ nà zhī xiǎodōngxī .
pairs.english: Only after Lohen checked the readings did Tavi pick up the little thing.
pairs.hanzi: 洛衡核完读数，塔维才拿起那只小东西。

pairs.target: zhǐtou méiyǒu fāmá , shēntǐ lǐ què yǒu yízhèn xiǎng xiào de chōngdòng ,
pairs.english: His fingers weren't numb, but an urge to laugh rose inside him,
pairs.hanzi: 指头没有发麻，身体里却有一阵想笑的冲动，

pairs.target: xiàng hěnjiǔyǐqián dìyīcì dúzì bānqǐ yìkuāng liào , pángbiān bìng méiyǒu rén bāng zhe tái .
pairs.english: like the first time long ago he'd lifted a basket of salvage alone, nobody helping beside him.
pairs.hanzi: 像很久以前第一次独自搬起一筐料，旁边并没有人帮着抬。

pairs.target: tā bǎ kǎkòu àn kāi , yòu hé shàng . tā fāchū pǔtōng de yìshēng kǎdā .
pairs.english: He opened the clasp and closed it. It made an ordinary click.
pairs.hanzi: 他把卡扣按开，又合上。它发出普通的一声咔嗒。

pairs.target: xiàwǔ ā duō láishí , tā méiyǒu xiān jiǎng zhège .
pairs.english: When Ado came that afternoon, he didn't begin with that story.
pairs.hanzi: 下午阿多来时，他没有先讲这个。

pairs.target: ā duō yě méiyǒu xiān wèn , zhī bǎ zìjǐ de jiù dēng fàngdào zhuōshàng , ràng tāmen zài zhuāng yícì .
pairs.english: Ado didn't ask first either, just set his old lamp on the table for them to fit again.
pairs.hanzi: 阿多也没有先问，只把自己的旧灯放到桌上，让他们再装一次。

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī yàn guò gùdìng hé gérè chù , réng zài shítái shàng diǎndēng , guò le yíhuìer cái ràng tā xì dào yāo biān .
pairs.english: Instructor Vey checked the mounting and insulation, lit it on the stone stand again, and waited before letting him fasten it at his waist.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师验过固定和隔热处，仍在石台上点灯，过了一会儿才让他系到腰边。

pairs.target: zhècì tā bào qǐ kōngxiāng , wǎng zuǒcè shēn , yòu wǎng yòuzhuǎn .
pairs.english: This time he lifted the empty crate and turned left, then right.
pairs.hanzi: 这次他抱起空箱，往左侧身，又往右转。

pairs.target: liàng chù cóng xié jiān pù dào qián wàifāng , méiyǒu zài zhèngmiàn liúxià shàngcì nàyàng yìzhěngkuài hēiyǐng .
pairs.english: Light spread from his shoe tips ahead and outward, without leaving the whole dark patch it had before.
pairs.hanzi: 亮处从鞋尖铺到前外方，没有在正面留下上次那样一整块黑影。

pairs.target: dào táijiē qián , tā xiān bǎ xiāngzǐ fàngxià , fú zhe lángān , mànmàn xià le sānjí .
pairs.english: At the stairs he put the crate down, held the railing, and slowly descended three steps.
pairs.hanzi: 到台阶前，他先把箱子放下，扶着栏杆，慢慢下了三级。

pairs.target: zhào yán de yǐngzi gēnzhe zǒu , què méiyǒu tūndiào yào luòjiǎo de nà yījí .
pairs.english: The hood's shadow followed, but didn't swallow the step he was about to take.
pairs.hanzi: 罩沿的影子跟着走，却没有吞掉要落脚的那一级。

pairs.target: " zhège kǒu liú dé hǎo . " tā shuō .
pairs.english: “That opening's good,” he said.
pairs.hanzi: “这个口留得好。”他说。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi kàn le sū yǐ yìyǎn . tā zhèng bǎ jiù zhào piàn wǎng bāo lǐ sāi , méi tīngjiàn .
pairs.english: Tavi glanced at Suyi. She was putting the old hood piece into her bag and hadn't heard.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维看了苏苡一眼。她正把旧罩片往包里塞，没听见。

pairs.target: tā jiào le tā yìshēng , bǎ ā duō dehuà chóngfù gěi tā .
pairs.english: He called her and repeated Ado's words.
pairs.hanzi: 他叫了她一声，把阿多的话重复给她。

pairs.target: shì wán , ā duō yào fù liào qián .
pairs.english: After the trial, Ado wanted to pay for materials.
pairs.hanzi: 试完，阿多要付料钱。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi náchū lǐngliào jìxià de zhǐ , biānjiǎo báopiàn shì huòzhǔn yòng de , bùdài quèshì tā mǎi de ,
pairs.english: Tavi brought out his material notes: the thin offcuts were approved for use, but he'd bought the cloth belt.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维拿出领料记下的纸，边角薄片是获准用的，布带却是他买的，

pairs.target: liǎnggè rén àn nà bǐ qián suàn , méiyǒu bǎ tóngxué de bāngmáng yě biānchéng yìbǐ qiànzhàng .
pairs.english: They settled that amount, without turning classmates' help into another debt.
pairs.hanzi: 两个人按那笔钱算，没有把同学的帮忙也编成一笔欠账。

pairs.target: ā duō dāying xiān zài yuànlǐ zuò duǎn huó , liúyì zhàozǐ rè qǐlái hòu huì buhuì pèng yīfu , zǒu chánglù réng dài tí bǐng .
pairs.english: Ado agreed to begin with short jobs in the yard, watching whether the hot hood touched clothing, and keep the handle for longer walks.
pairs.hanzi: 阿多答应先在院里做短活，留意罩子热起来后会不会碰衣服，走长路仍带提柄。

pairs.target: " nà wǒ shénme shíhòu néng chāikāi kànkàn ? " tā wèn .
pairs.english: “When can I take it apart to look?” he asked.
pairs.hanzi: “那我什么时候能拆开看看？”他问。

pairs.target: " xiān xīdēng , fàng liáng . kǎkòu shì zhèyàng . "
pairs.english: “Put out the flame and let it cool first. The clasp works like this.”
pairs.hanzi: “先熄灯，放凉。卡扣是这样。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yǎnshì le yíbiàn , yòu ràng tā zìjǐ lái .
pairs.english: Tavi demonstrated once, then let him do it.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维演示了一遍，又让他自己来。

pairs.target: ā duō àn cuò yícè , dìyīcì méi kāi , dìèrcì cái bǎ dēng qǔ xià , lùchū xiàng zhuōzhù shénme xiǎobǎxì de xiào .
pairs.english: Ado pressed the wrong side and failed first, then detached the lamp on his second try, smiling as if he'd caught a little trick.
pairs.hanzi: 阿多按错一侧，第一次没开，第二次才把灯取下，露出像捉住什么小把戏的笑。

pairs.target: tāmen zài ménkǒu fēnkāi .
pairs.english: They parted at the gate.
pairs.hanzi: 他们在门口分开。

pairs.target: dēng hái méi diǎn , ā duō tí zài shǒulǐ , kuāndài dā zài jiānshàng .
pairs.english: The lamp was unlit; Ado carried it by hand, the broad belt over his shoulder.
pairs.hanzi: 灯还没点，阿多提在手里，宽带搭在肩上。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zhídào zhèshíhòu cái xiǎng qǐlái , zìjǐ yuánběn hěn xiǎng gàosù tā nà méi xiāo shì zěnyàng chuān jìnqù de .
pairs.english: Only now did Tavi remember how much he'd wanted to tell him how the pin went in.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维直到这时候才想起来，自己原本很想告诉他那枚销是怎样穿进去的。

pairs.target: huí dōng wū , luò héng wèn dōngxī sòngzǒu méiyǒu .
pairs.english: Back in the east room, Lohen asked whether it had gone.
pairs.hanzi: 回东屋，洛衡问东西送走没有。

pairs.target: tā diǎntóu , bǎ kōng qiǎndié xǐjìng , cāgān hòu fàng huí jiàshàng .
pairs.english: He nodded, washed the empty dish, dried it, and returned it to the shelf.
pairs.hanzi: 他点头，把空浅碟洗净，擦干后放回架上。

pairs.target: dié dǐ yǒu yídào jiù huàhén , tā yòng mǔzhǐ cèng le yíxià , méi cèng diào , yě méiyǒu zài cèng .
pairs.english: An old scratch marked its bottom; he rubbed it with his thumb, couldn't remove it, and didn't rub again.
pairs.hanzi: 碟底有一道旧划痕，他用拇指蹭了一下，没蹭掉，也没有再蹭。
